name: straddle planche
description: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor or on parallettes, shoulder-width apart.
Lock your elbows and lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor and spread your legs wide.
Hold your body level with the floor, arms straight and core and glutes tight.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower your feet with control.
